youtube.titulo: How sand becomes a computer chip 💾 Stuck in 2026, Ep. 3
youtube.descricao:
The tiny brain inside Kip's Chrono-Band has burned out, and nobody in 2026 sells parts from the future. Ben finds an old phone's circuit board in a drawer, and Kip learns where its chip came from: silica sand is purified into almost perfect silicon, grown into one big crystal and sliced into thin discs. Then light prints circuit patterns onto each disc, layer after layer, until one chip holds billions of transistors. Then the machine asks its first question.

Episode 3 of 6 of "Stuck in 2026". Where exactly is Kip? Comment below.

The future world in this video (Lumen, the Chrono-Band and the time machine) is fiction. The chip explanation is based on how silicon microchips are made (sources: imec "How are microchips made?", ASML "Lithography principles", Samsung Newsroom, TechRadar). Never open a phone or puncture its battery.

tiktok.legenda: The brain of your phone started as SAND 🏖️➡️💾 Kip needed a new chip to get home from 2026… and found out it's printed with light. Ep. 3/6. Did you know this? 👇
